title: Verizon Communications Set to Report Q3 Earnings Amidst Competitive Landscape
excerpt: Analysts expect Verizon to report EPS of $1.27, up from $1.21 last year.
body:
Verizon Communications, a leading telecommunications company, operates primarily in wireless and wireline services. Its main business segments include Verizon Wireless, which provides mobile services, and Verizon Business, which offers communication solutions for enterprises. As the company prepares to report its earnings, investors are keenly focused on its performance in a highly competitive market.

Verizon is set to report its fiscal Q3 earnings on October 26, 2026, before the market opens. This quarter is particularly significant as it follows a period of intense competition in the telecom sector, with rivals aggressively pursuing market share and pricing strategies.

The market consensus for this quarter's earnings per share (EPS) is forecasted at $1.27, based on seven analyst estimates. This represents an increase from the EPS of $1.21 reported in the same quarter last year. Investors will be closely monitoring revenue trends across its segments, especially in wireless, where subscriber growth and ARPU (average revenue per user) are critical indicators.

Additionally, margin pressures and operational costs will be scrutinized, particularly in light of rising inflation and supply chain challenges. Guidance for future quarters and capital returns, including dividends and share buybacks, will also be key focal points for investors. Beyond Verizon, this earnings report will serve as a bellwether for the telecommunications sector, influencing investor sentiment and market dynamics.
author: Diaspora Desk
